purpose: Optional persistent mutable Player Character handoff state. Create a named file only when repository tracking is needed beyond the player's normal tabletop sheet.
rules: The player's authoritative character sheet may remain the source for turn-by-turn HP, spell slots and other ephemeral resources.
Persist only mutable values that must survive the handoff or are not reliably owned by the normal tabletop sheet.
Player agency is never delegated by this file.
Use null or empty collections when a value is not established.
Static item mechanics belong in inventory/, not in this state file.
